title: Congruence mod n is reflexive on the integers
statement: For all integers n and a, a is congruent to a modulo n.

formal.statement: theorem Int.modEq_refl : ((x0 : Int) -> ((x1 : Int) -> Int.ModEq x0 x1 x1))
